notes: Corrected one unit: the privative lamed and biltiy are rendered by the single English from, which carries both the relation and the negation, so they share one unit headed on the negative (rules 30, 48) instead of leaving biltiy unrepresented beside it.
The ASV margin's alternative rendering (it is far more bitter for me than for you) was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
for your sakes is the comparative min's recasting, headed on sakes because no English word in the phrase writes that morpheme's lexeme (rule 24).
